DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis (Listeria monocytogenes infection)

I have reached the limit of my questions for today. Given your pregnancy at 30 weeks, the consumption of unpasteurized ice cream three days prior, and the sudden onset of fever, headache, and flu-like symptoms without gastrointestinal distress, this is highly suggestive of listeriosis. We need to confirm this immediately.

REQUEST TEST: Listeria monocytogenes blood culture and serology.
REQUEST IMAGES: None currently indicated pending lab results.
